#### `stc.relics.hardening.audit.enable`

Whether to enable auditd with STC's baseline audit ruleset (identity, sudoers, setuid execve, kernel modules, mounts).

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/hardening/audit.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/hardening/audit.nix)

#### `stc.relics.hardening.audit.immutable`

Lock the audit configuration until the next reboot (`auditctl -e 2`,
`security.audit.enable = "lock"`). Root can then neither remove nor
change the rules: a nixos-rebuild switch that touches them fails the
audit-rules-nixos unit until the machine reboots.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/hardening/audit.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/hardening/audit.nix)
